name: Hifadhi Blu Marine Conservation Area Management Grants

funder.name: WIOMSA with Advanced Conservation Strategies, WIOMPAN and Minderoo Foundation

administered_by.name: Western Indian Ocean Marine Science Association (WIOMSA)

summary: Cohort grants of up to USD 200,000 over two years to strengthen on-the-ground management of marine conservation areas in the Western Indian Ocean, open to site managers such as community groups, non-profits and agencies.

amount.note: Up to USD 200,000 in total over two years (2026-2028)

status.quote: Following a competitive regional call for proposals, nine sites from Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique, Madagascar, Seychelles, Mauritius (Rodrigues), Somalia and South Africa were selected

deadline.quote: These letters should be submitted via WIOMSA Proposal Central by 29 November 2025 at 11:59 PM EAT.

applicant_types.quote: Local and national non-profits. · Community conservation groups. · Government agencies managing marine sites. · Research organisations with management mandates. · Private entities with formal responsibility for marine conservation sites.

geography.quote: Projects must focus on marine conservation sites within the WIO region, covering the following 10 countries: South Africa, Comoros, France (Réunion), Kenya, Madagascar, Mauritius, Mozambique, Seychelles, Somalia, and Tanzania.

access.quote: All calls will be made through the news/blog outlets of Hifadhi Blu, WIOMSA and WIOMPAN.

window.quote: Stage 1 concept note submissions close at 11.59 pm EAT on the 31st of January 2025.

amount.quote: Each grant will provide up to USD 200,000 total for the two-year period (2026-2028)

administered_by.quote: Hifadhi Blu, led by WIOMSA, aims to enhance the management of marine conservation sites in the WIO through grants
